questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne opleve japansk landskabsarkitektur fra et akademisk udgangspunkt. Derudover finder jeg Japan meget inspirerende og ville gerne opleve hverdagen i Tokyo.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var rimeligt nemt dog var der meget papirarbejde man skal have styr på både ifht universitetet, men også ifht visum.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Meget hjælp fra universitetet og mange mails med informationer. Derudover var der studerende fra universitetet, der hjalp til med nye studerende, der var meget hjælpsomme og venlige.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Man kunne enten bo på Komaba campus eller et andet sted, som lå langt fra begge campus man kunne have fag på.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Man skulle selv sørge for mad. Mit værelse havde toilet og bad, men intet køkken så jeg måtte benytte det fælleskøkken, som desværre ikke var så renligt og rart at lave mad i.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Det dorm som ligger på Komaba campus er godt ifht beliggenhed og okay at bo i.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man kunne registrere sig igennem et system på nettet, som virkede meget fint.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Universitetet kunne hjælpe, hvis man havde brug for det. Derudover kunne man få meget hjælp fra udvekslingskontoret på UTokyo.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Der var kun et fag, der gav mening for mig at tage ifht min uddannelse inden for landskabsarkitektur. Desværre kan man ikke se de kurser man kan tage inden, da UTokyo ændre kurserne hvert halve år.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Vær fleksibel med kurser for det er ikke sikkert man kan tage de kurser som er i deres kursuskatalog. Jeg var desværre skuffet over de kurser der blev tilbudt. Det er meget begrænset, hvilke kurser man kan tage, da der ikke er mange kurser, som bliver undervist på engelsk.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Undervisningsniveauet var lavere end på KU dog er eksamensformen helt anderledes - man skal aflevere "final papers" i alle fag så man sidder og skriver mange stile. Derudover er det op til den enkelte professor, hvordan eksamensformen er - eller hvilket format de vil have.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det er typisk klasseundervisning, hvor der i de fleste fag bliver taget fravær. Hvis man har for meget fravær kan man risikere at dumpe faget. Man har typisk mange fag ca. 7 og et fag én gang om ugen. Man kan dog strukturere sin uge efter, hvilke fag man vælger. I nogle fag afhænger ens "final grade" også af, hvor meget man siger i timerne.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Global Liberal Arts（History of the Japanese Environment: Architecture & Cities, Gardens & Landscape）
Global Liberal Arts（Disinformation, Fake News, and Post-Truth Politics in a Global Context）
Global Liberal Arts（Japanese Philosophy and the Global World）
Topics in Cross-disciplinary Studies I ( Experiencing Japanese religions)
Special Topics I (Seminar) [British Studies] (British Landscape Writing)
Urban Planning Technology I
Japanese Introductory(S2)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Japanese Introductory(S2)	
Underviserne er meget gode og venlige og vil meget gerne lære fra sig. 

Special Topics I (Seminar) [British Studies] (British Landscape Writing)
Spændende kursus med en meget god underviser.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Man bruger ret meget på transport især fordi man har typisk fag både på Komaba og Hongo campus, der ligger ca. en time fra hinanden i tog.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Mad er meget billigt især hvis det er hjemmelavet mad man laver.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der var mange clubber man kunne være medlem af. Derudover organiserede udviklingsafdelingen en masse aktiviteter for udvekslingsstuderende.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Der bliver holdt "lunch gatherings" som er en god måde at møde andre på.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Hvis man har tid og penge er det oplagt at tage weekendture til fx Kyoto, Kamakura osv.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt synes jeg. Jeg tog afsted lidt før jeg skulle starte på universitetet så jeg havde vænnet mig til at være i Japan, da jeg startede på UTokyo.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Man kommer til at møde mange udvekslingsstuderende fra mange forskellige lande til undervisning. Der er også mange sociale arrangementer man kan være med til fx May Festival.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Man skal vænne sig til travle Tokyo og den sprogbarriere der er, men man vænner sig hurtigt til det.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Hverdagen og de stille steder man kan finde i Tokyo.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Undersøg om der er relevante fag at tage på UTokyo.
Lær lidt basic japansk, som man kan bruge når man køber ind - fx hej, tak, undskyld, nej tak, ja tak osv.
Man skal kunne rumme Tokyos travle hverdag, mange mennesker og sprogbarrieren, men udover det er Japan fantastisk og UTokyo giver muligheden for at kunne bo i Tokyo og studere samtidigt.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Man kommer til at sidde meget i offentlig transport så det skal man acceptere - altså hvis man har fag på begge campus.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At få en hverdag i Tokyo.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Det kan være svært med tidsforskellen nogle gange når man vil ringe hjem.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
